body:
Production build on `main` fails with 5 `Module not found` errors ΓÇö packages imported in source but never added to `package.json`.

### Missing dependencies

| Package | File | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `@xterm/xterm` | `src/components/studio/TerminalPanel.tsx` | client |
| `@xterm/addon-fit` | `src/components/studio/TerminalPanel.tsx` | client |
| `dockerode` | `src/lib/emergent/runner/docker-manager.ts` | server |
| `ioredis` | `src/lib/cache/redis.ts` | server |

### Changes

- **`package.json`** ΓÇö Add `@xterm/xterm`, `@xterm/addon-fit`, `dockerode`, `ioredis` as dependencies; `@types/dockerode` as devDependency
- **`next.config.js`** ΓÇö Add `dockerode` and `ioredis` to `serverExternalPackages` so Turbopack doesn't attempt to bundle Node-native server modules into client bundles

```js
// next.config.js
serverExternalPackages: ['dockerode', 'ioredis'],
```

All packages checked against GitHub Advisory Database ΓÇö no known vulnerabilities.
